b: Quill Kukla, who recently resigned from their position at as professor of philosophy at Georgetown University, has accepted a position as Chair of Social Philosophy of Science and Language at Leibniz University Hannover (LUH).

Professor Kukla works across a wide range of areas, including philosophy of place, philosophy of geography, ethics, applied philosophy of science, philosophy of language, epistemology, disability studies,, philosophy of health and medicine, and aesthetics. Their recent books include Sex Beyond ‘Yes!’: Pleasure and Agency for Everyone (2025) and City Living: How Urban Spaces and Urban Dwellers Make One Another (2021). You can learn more about their work here.
At LUH, Kukla will be working on their ERC-funded project, TERRAINS: Territory, Agency, and Inhabiting Space, the details of which (including open positions) can be found here.

In addition to their new position as Chair in Social Philosophy of Science and Language, at LUH Kukla is also a Humboldt Visiting Researcher as well as an affiliate of the SOCRATES Centre for Advanced Studies.
